label: sec:enveloping-algebras
html: To connect the finite-dimensional Iwahori–Hecke quotient H_n(q) to the representation category of a quantum group, the quantized universal enveloping algebra \mathcal{U}_q(\mathfrak{su}(2)) over \mathbb{Q}(q) is constructed. Its center is generated by a unique q-deformed Casimir operator C_q that reduces to the classical quadratic Casimir as q \to 1, and its universal R-matrix induces the ribbon-category braiding on \mathbf{Rep}(\mathcal{U}_q(\mathfrak{su}(2))) whose centralizer algebra on V^{\otimes n} is H_n(q) by quantum Schur–Weyl duality.
